fields.summary_ko.0: HSBC upgraded Tesla (TSLA) from 'Reduce' to 'Hold' and raised target price from $157 to $359; however, the strategic value of Tesla-SpaceX merger is assessed as limited.
fields.summary_ko.1: HSBC values Tesla at $507 per share (33% premium to 30-day average price) under merger scenario and $212 under standalone operations.
